limits: Real required-check resolver/wait projection with recorded REST responses and real jq, one poll, no live provider or merge. Covers wrong-app/plain-status spoof and same-identity red/pending hidden by last green. Historical anchor admits all bad cases. Full-entrypoint tests separately cover rulesets, opposite order, effects and head pin. BAD-to-GOOD mutation restores the app or removes the adverse duplicate. Mixed legacy/app requirements include a literal pipe in a legacy status name; typed JSON-encoded identities must reject the spoof. Adverse duplicate rows have different suite IDs and are returned by latest-attempt reads; the GOOD rerun has a superseded red in the same suite, removed by filter=latest. It must merge without an admin override.
